brief.text: The international break has turned into a treatment-room saga. Saliba, Rice, Havertz and Christos Tzolis are all doubts for Leeds, and new reports from France suggest Saliba's return date could shift, though nobody has put a firm number on it yet. Tzolis is the messy one: he was sent home from Greece after picking up an injury and arguing with the manager over his substitution, and Daily Cannon has an Arsenal international out for two to three weeks. Jurrien Timber is the brighter story after breaking a 24-year Dutch record and giving his own fitness update, even if the Dutch press weren't kind to him and his brother. As for the Erling Haaland chatter, there's no "Here we go" anywhere near it, so treat it as pure rumour and enjoy it as background noise.
